headline: FBI Arrests 6 Rappers in Texas-Louisiana Joint Operation
body: FBI Houston Spokesperson Connor Hagen confirmed to TMZ that six individuals, including rappers Ben10 and OG 3Three, were arrested by federal agents and partner agencies this morning across Louisiana and Texas. The U.S. Attorney’s Office for the Southern District of Texas has yet to disclose specific charges. Authorities are directing all inquiries about charges to their office, leaving details unclear.
